title: Existing-Client Project Setup target application flow

surfaces.currentBehavior: Core-only observable existing-Client Project Setup application model combines exact local evidence, owns the guarded three-step workflow and exact allocation input semantics, freezes an immutable admitted draft, manages fail-closed selection and retry identities, and follows local acceptance through the typed Project-creation operation watch.
surfaces.notes: The previously verified application flow now also owns and drains every admitted observer/submission across concurrent lifecycle calls. Independent correction review is GO; exact correction CI remains pending.

syncRequirements: Preserve partial, stale, ready, incomplete, and authoritative-empty distinctions without inventing completeness

migration.rule: Create no source import or transformation.
reconciliation: Use stable typed Client/category identities rather than copied display text

acceptance: The real model passes two-stream, selection, submission, receipt, cancellation, and error tests

surfaces.currentBehavior: Twenty-three deterministic Project Setup tests cover independently arriving evidence, false-empty meaning, guarded navigation, compiled SwiftUI control/action wiring, one-time category defaults, exact allocation semantics, immutable in-flight submission, queued-to-applied and queued-to-rejected observation, honest post-acceptance reference failures, malformed evidence, retry identity, observer generation isolation, lifecycle drainage and shutdown.
